sources.limitations: Adresa zgrade iz OSM-a (addr:street + addr:housenumber); nije potvrđen ulaz u poslovni prostor. Isti PBF kao D08.
sources.note: Imported together with D08 by 'osm-import --file'. DGU INSPIRE addresses (Otvorena dozvola) remain a pilot option: GML via WFS/Atom for all of Croatia.
